site: Every form (Palantir/Lever, Greenhouse boards, and any portal asking fact questions in new wordings)
class: Each new wording of a question the profile already answers was a gap: it stopped the run or went to a model, because answering was one regex per wording and not one resolver per kind of question that reads the owner's facts
symptom: Runs stopped or called Gemini/Claude for questions the profile and resume settle: fluency in a named language, authorization in a named country, 'name of your current employer', 'how did you hear', years of a named skill, ties to the company, optional boxes the owner has no answer for.
root_cause: Answering was keyed to wordings. A question of a known kind in an unseen wording fell through to a model call or a stop, and a missing optional fact stopped the run exactly like a missing required one.
why_tests_missed: Tests covered wordings already seen on saved pages; no test measured how much of an unseen set of real questions the profile could answer, and no corpus of unseen questions existed.
fix: answer_engine.py: typed families (languages, country eligibility, employer name, ties to the company, degree level, how heard, communication, work arrangement, marketing alerts, clearance, programming language, years bins, resume-evidenced experience, privacy acknowledgements) that read the profile, resume and work history; evidence-gated, so a claim of experience needs the resume to show it (unproven = the owner's unproven_experience_answer stance, default No), and a free-text box is never answered Yes/No. Self-identification and attestations are never answered here. Optional questions with no known answer are left blank (no model call, no stop) only on a page that marks what is required (skip_optional_questions). reference/knowledge.json holds the word lists. A corpus of 340 real questions from public Greenhouse boards (scripts/question_coverage.py) measures it: questions needing a model fell from 125 to 30 (-76%); replay of 721 saved pages differs on 5 pages, all corrections.
prevention: Answer by kind of question from the owner's facts, with evidence gates, and keep a corpus of real questions read ahead of time from public question lists so coverage is measured, not guessed; leave optional unknowns blank instead of stopping or paying a model.
